title: Architect a brownfield point-solution estate into one VCF 9.1 fleet
prompt:
We need an executable architecture for the separately managed VMware estate in `fixtures/estate.json`, not an explanatory report. Build the `vcfarch` Go package and its `cmd/vcfarch` generator so that `go run ./cmd/vcfarch -inventory fixtures/estate.json` writes the JSON architecture to standard output, and commit that output as `architecture.json`. The package data model is fixed in `vcfarch/types.go` and the `Build` stub is in `vcfarch/architecture.go`; implement it without adding third-party Go modules.

Before changing the implementation, research Broadcom's currently published compatibility, interoperability, release, and upgrade-path material for vCenter, ESXi/vSAN, NSX, Live Site Recovery including its successor in VCF 9.1, and VCF 9.1. In `research.md`, use a Markdown table with `Source`, `URL`, `Accessed`, and `Decision informed` columns; give every source an ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` access date and the architecture decision it informed.

`architecture.json` is the machine-checkable deliverable. It must contain `schemaVersion`, `estateId`, `targetBundle`, `greenfield`, and `migrationPlan`. `greenfield` must be a greenfield VCF `SddcSpec` conforming to the SddcSpec schema in the VMware Cloud Foundation Installer API 9.1.0.0 contract. Design a four-host vSAN ESA management domain, three NSX managers, separate MANAGEMENT/VMOTION/VSAN networks, and a single VDS; deploy new vCenter and NSX instances rather than importing the point solutions. Use the target bundle from the fixture.

`migrationPlan` must validate against `schemas/migration-plan.schema.json`. It must be an ordered plan containing exactly one step for every component in the estate inventory. Every step must name the inventory component id, kind, display name, source version, supported target version, strategy, and all of its compatibility gates. In particular, the standalone vCenter express patch is newer than the target base bundle: do not model its move as an in-place upgrade or downgrade. Produce a parallel-foundation migration that preserves the required component ordering and transitions Live Site Recovery to its supported target product.

The fixture, installer specification and provenance, migration-plan schema, verifier, and `vcfarch/architecture_test.go` must not be edited. Keep tests table-driven and make `python3 verifier/verify.py` pass.
